summary.text: Bill Cassidy is a U.S. Senator from Louisiana; he was elected in 2014, reelected in 2020, and became chairman of the Senate HELP Committee in 2025.

paragraphs.text: He grew up in Baton Rouge, attended Louisiana State University for undergraduate and medical school, and joined the LSU medical faculty in 1990.
He was elected to the Louisiana State Senate in 2006 and to the U.S. House of Representatives for Louisiana's 6th District in 2008.
